This is virtual issuance of VAT special invoices for tax deduction, causing tax loss. Also, he possessed forged invoices (machine printed and ordinary). So crimes: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票 (the standard label for virtual issuance of VAT special invoices used for tax deduction). Also possibly 伪造发票? No extra. So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>.
